hypothesis: Class-balanced factual decision supervision mixes unidentifiable hidden-sign examples with identifiable examples. Restricting training to actually observed informative fifth interventions may permit raw neural choice learning; giving an explicit observed-effect×public-return-action interaction may separate information identifiability from neural feature-learning. No hidden q/counterfactual return is supplied to a model.

factual_source.informative_pair_selection: from factual public fifth-action/context key, match selected fifth action==public context

arms.raw: Unchanged R35 48D P80 raw fifth action/effect and candidate return key MLP
arms.gated: Same R35 48D raw P80 plus 4 public factual features: fifth==context, return==context, joint indicator, joint*(inverse-normalized actual fifth physical displacement minus FIT-only safe/noninformative fifth baseline). Never pass generator q/sign, learned coefficient or return effect
arms.gated_offset: FIT selected observed noninformative fifth consequences only, no score/heldout values
arms.shuffled_negative: For informative factual pairs only, use actually selected fifth effect from opposite-sign FIT episode with same g,c,magnitude,public actions/B/fifth; return labels from original factual selected pair. This destroys sign informativeness and is NEGATIVE CONTROL ONLY, never a valid factual positive experiment.

training.same_sampling_keys_for_all_models: one uniform int list on 0..1151 per update. mixed uses direct, informative maps modulo 576 into sorted informative FIT indices; shuffled same informative index as gated_informative
training.loss: cross entropy -candidate logits over the two separately selected factual return action outcomes, lower factual squared-goal cost wins
training.heldout_validation: 192 identifiable FIT validation pairs and 192 noninformative FIT pairs reported separately, never optimized

evaluation.eraser: erase only actual selected fifth effect, preserve selected fifth action and nuisance B
